tagline.zh: 痛苦持续伤害、恶魔学识宠物或毁灭爆发。
tagline.en: Affliction damage-over-time, Demonology pets, or Destruction burst.

strengths.zh: 宠物协助单人，持续伤害稳定，生存手段多。
strengths.en: Pet-assisted soloing, steady DoT damage, many survival tools.

drawbacks.zh: 爆发偏慢，技能循环较繁琐。
drawbacks.en: Slower burst and a busier rotation.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Class list and roles per Blizzard class deep-dive posts; tree data extracted from beta client.
